info.name: MNTN Async Batch Export API - Batch

description.content:
## Overview

Submit long-running **CSV** exports of reporting queries, poll **status**, then download results via
**time-limited signed URLs**. Endpoints are under **`/batch`…** (requires `r2ds.exports.enabled`).

## Lifecycle

1. **`POST /batch`** — enqueue a job; response includes `batchId` and initial status (**202 Accepted**).
2. **`GET /batch/{batchId}`** — status; when `SUCCEEDED`, a fresh **download URL** may be included.
3. **`POST /batch/{batchId}/regenerate-url`** — issue a new signed URL without re-running the query.
4. **`GET /batch`** — list recent jobs (optional `status`, `limit`, `offset` query params).
